payload.query: How should I wash my wool sweater?

args.text:
To wash your wool sweater, you can either wash it by hand in cool water (at most 30 °C) using a wool or mild detergent, or use the wool cycle on a washing machine [fabric-care#1]. To reduce new pilling, you can wash the knitwear inside out on a gentle cycle [fabric-care#2]. 

When washing, do not wring or twist the garment [fabric-care#1]. Instead, press the water out by rolling it in a towel [fabric-care#1]. To dry, lay it flat on a towel away from direct sunlight and radiators; do not hang wet wool as it will stretch, and avoid hot water or tumble drying as these can cause shrinking and felting [fabric-care#1]. 

Additionally, wool does not need to be washed as frequently as cotton; airing it out overnight between wears is often sufficient [fabric-care#1].
